cards.card_text: The Benjamites drive the Jebusites out of Jerusalem.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: So the Jebusites are still living right there among the Benjamites when this was written.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: He's from the hill country of Ephraim too, living here in Gibeah, where the men are Benjamites.
cards.verse_text: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was residing in Gibeah (the men of that place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the field.
cards.snippet: …Ephraim, who was residing in Gibeah (the men of that place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the field.

cards.card_text: Meanwhile, the Benjamites, the men of the tribe of Benjamin, hear that Israel has gone up to Mizpah.
cards.verse_text: (Meanwhile the Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) And the Israelites asked, “Tell us, how did this wicked thing happen?”
cards.snippet: (Meanwhile the Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) And the Israelites…

cards.card_text: The Benjamites hand the wicked men of Gibeah over to the rest of Israel.
cards.verse_text: Hand over the wicked men of Gibeah so we can put them to death and purge Israel of this evil.” But the Benjamites refused to heed the voice of their fellow Israelites.
cards.snippet: …put them to death and purge Israel of this evil.” But the Benjamites refused to heed the voice of their fellow Israelites.

cards.card_text: From their cities, the Benjamites come together at Gibeah to fight Israel: 26,000 swordsmen, plus the 700 select men of Gibeah.
cards.verse_text: On that day the Benjamites mobilized 26,000 swordsmen from their cities, in addition to the 700 select men of Gibeah.
cards.snippet: On that day the Benjamites mobilized 26,000 swordsmen from their cities, in addition to the 700 select…

cards.card_text: Israel sets out, goes up to Bethel and asks God, "Who of us shall go up first to fight against the Benjamites?" "Judah will be first," the LORD replies.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites set out, went up to Bethel, and inquired of God, “Who of us shall go up first to fight against the Benjamites?” “Judah will be first,” the LORD replied.
cards.snippet: …God, “Who of us shall go up first to fight against the Benjamites?” “Judah will be first,” the LORD replied.

cards.card_text: The Benjamites come out of Gibeah and cut down 22,000 Israelites that day.
cards.verse_text: And the Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down 22,000 Israelites on the battlefield that day.
cards.snippet: And the Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down 22,000 Israelites on the battlefield…

cards.card_text: When Israel asks about fighting their brothers the Benjamites again, the LORD tells them to go up against them.
cards.verse_text: They went up and wept before the LORD until evening, inquiring of Him, “Should we again draw near for battle against our brothers the Benjamites?” And the LORD answered, “Go up against them.”
cards.snippet: …Him, “Should we again draw near for battle against our brothers the Benjamites?” And the LORD answered, “Go up against them.”

cards.card_text: And once again, the Benjamites come out of Gibeah against them.
cards.verse_text: On the second day the Israelites advanced against the Benjamites.
cards.snippet: On the second day the Israelites advanced against the Benjamites.

cards.card_text: This time, Israel also asks the LORD whether they should stop fighting the Benjamites.
cards.verse_text: and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, served before it.) The Israelites asked, “Should we again go out to battle against our brothers the Benjamites, or should we stop?” The LORD answered, “Fight, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand.”

cards.card_text: On the third day, the Benjamites come out against Israel.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city.

cards.card_text: "We are defeating them as before," say the Benjamites.
cards.verse_text: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city.
cards.snippet: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city.

cards.card_text: The men of Israel plan to retreat and pull the Benjamites out onto the roads.
cards.verse_text: “We are defeating them as before,” said the Benjamites.
cards.snippet: “We are defeating them as before,” said the Benjamites.

cards.card_text: During the fierce battle at Gibeah, the Benjamites can tell that disaster is coming for them.
cards.verse_text: But the Benjamites did not realize that disaster was upon them.
cards.snippet: But the Benjamites did not realize that disaster was upon them.

cards.card_text: That day, Israel strikes down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
cards.verse_text: The LORD defeated Benjamin in the presence of Israel, and on that day the Israelites slaughtered 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
cards.snippet: …the presence of Israel, and on that day the Israelites slaughtered 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.

cards.card_text: The Benjamites strike down about thirty men of Israel and say, "They are defeated before us as in the first battle."
cards.verse_text: When the Benjamites had begun to strike them down, killing about thirty men of Israel, they said, “They are defeated before us as in the first battle.”
cards.snippet: When the Benjamites had begun to strike them down, killing about thirty men of Israel,…

cards.card_text: When the signal goes up, the Benjamites look behind them.
cards.verse_text: But when the column of smoke began to go up from the city, the Benjamites looked behind them and saw the whole city going up in smoke.
cards.snippet: …the column of smoke began to go up from the city, the Benjamites looked behind them and saw the whole city going up in smoke.

cards.card_text: Israel surrounds them near Gibeah on the east, and 18,000 Benjamites fall, then 5,000 more on the roads and 2,000 at Gidom.
cards.verse_text: They surrounded the Benjamites, pursued them, and easily overtook them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.
cards.snippet: They surrounded the Benjamites, pursued them, and easily overtook them in the vicinity of Gibeah on…

cards.card_text: And the men of Israel turn back against the other Benjamites.
cards.verse_text: And the men of Israel turned back against the other Benjamites and put to the sword all the cities, including the animals and everything else they found.
cards.snippet: And the men of Israel turned back against the other Benjamites and put to the sword all the cities, including the animals and…

cards.card_text: And the Israelites grieve for their brothers, the Benjamites.
cards.verse_text: And the Israelites grieved for their brothers, the Benjamites, and said, “Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.
cards.snippet: And the Israelites grieved for their brothers, the Benjamites, and said, “Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.

cards.card_text: Then the whole congregation sends a message of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.
cards.verse_text: Then the whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites who were at the rock of Rimmon.
cards.snippet: Then the whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites who were at the rock of Rimmon.

cards.card_text: The Benjamites return and are given the women spared from Jabesh-gilead.
cards.verse_text: And at that time the Benjamites returned and were given the women who were spared from Jabesh-gilead.
cards.snippet: And at that time the Benjamites returned and were given the women who were spared from Jabesh-gilead.

cards.card_text: For the feast at Shiloh, where do the elders tell the Benjamites to go and hide?
cards.verse_text: So they commanded the Benjamites: “Go, hide in the vineyards
cards.snippet: So they commanded the Benjamites: “Go, hide in the vineyards

cards.card_text: And the Benjamites do as instructed.

cards.snippet: The Benjamites did as instructed and carried away the number of women they needed…

cards.verse_text: The Benjamites rallied to Abner, formed a single unit, and took their stand atop a hill.

cards.card_text: The Benjamites come with 956 relatives, and the priests with 1,760, all able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
cards.verse_text: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah; and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy.
cards.snippet: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;…

cards.card_text: Then more Benjamites and some men from Judah come to David's stronghold, and David goes out to meet them.
cards.verse_text: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
cards.snippet: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
